sections.Profile:
The 4 Aces pinball machine, released by Williams Electronic Games Inc. in March 1970, was designed by Steve Kordek with artwork by Louis Raynaud. This electro-mechanical game features a widebody cabinet and supports two players. It includes four flippers, seven hanging targets, and stop magnets that create unique gameplay dynamics.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1970
